conclusions: CNR-enabled initial result, selected tuning, cached exposure and packed bytes match complete original constructor/callback/converter.
Enabling CNR stalls first raw RX completion; no statistics or output images arrive. Clearing only its enable bit restores capture.
YUV422 flag, alternate thumbnail mode and exploratory bypassed YNR did not resolve the stall. No YNR dependency claim follows.
Device enumeration confirms video11 is rkisp_mainpath; the self-path hypothesis was incorrect.
Default compile-time LIVE_CNR_ENABLED gate remains false. Its restored executable passes capture/application and all existing live native checks.
Kernel/runtime CNR startup cause remains unidentified. CNR is not counted as a working feature.
limitations: Numerical startup comparison is not a successful hardware capture.
Kernel allocator warnings also appeared with working captures; not established as the CNR failure cause.
Read-only MMIO observes registers but does not prove all driver/cache state or diagnose root cause.
No optical QR, physical display/buttons, cold power-cycle or full profile parity qualification.
